3d semantic segmentation.name: 3D semantic segmentation
3d semantic segmentation.description: 3D semantic segmentation assigns a semantic class label to each point in a 3D scene or point cloud, enabling the scene to be parsed into meaningful object or component categories.

construction drawing understanding.name: Construction drawing understanding
construction drawing understanding.description: Construction drawing understanding interprets construction drawings and related sheet information, including symbols, notes, dimensions, views, and cross-references, to extract meaning, answer questions, or reason over design and construction intent.
